title: Kyle Shanahan injured in car accident: 49ers coach to begin training camp in limited role

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Kyle Shanahan injured in car accident: 49ers coach to begin training camp in limited role
sources.description: Reports say Shanahan suffered a broken nose, three broken ribs, a broken hand, a concussion and required more than 40 stitches to his face after the July 14 crash
